items.description: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set), 2 pcs
items.rationale: Overvoltage from atmospheric discharge (2.3.3) is insured and both appliances were damaged. Indemnity is capped by the EUR 5,000 appliance sub-limit and by 7.1.9. No surge protector was used, so the amount is halved under 2.3.3. The market value is a guess: roughly 1,500 EUR for TV and speakers, halved to about 750 EUR.

items.description: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out, 3 pcs
items.rationale: Diagnostic report and measuring work are the contractor's own diagnostic outlay (7.1.8(e)). The call-out charge (7.1.8(d)) is not indemnifiable because no indemnifiable repair work is billed on this invoice. No repair cost is shown, so t is 0.
